authorization.decision_reference: User instruction 2026-11-18 to determine the recommended acceptance values from the paper and implementation, adopt them, and proceed with the pending NAV-065 evaluation.

decision_basis.paper: So, Ge and Fan (NeurIPS 2024), Eq. 13 and deployment procedure: find the least feasible budget for the deterministic actor via a one-dimensional value search.
decision_basis.implementation: RC-PPO root_finding.py evaluates max(energy value minus budget, reach value plus threshold); arguments.py defaults to threshold 0. CaMRA terminal-tail-v5 preserves beta=0 and normalizes signed budget and cost value by the same fixed J scale.
decision_basis.feasibility: A false feasible start can invalidate the selected budget. Require zero per candidate on the named 30 starts; require all six known feasible primary starts to pass so always-reject cannot qualify. These are empirical counts on development, not a population safety guarantee.
decision_basis.error_metrics: Retain the CaMRA NAV-038 amended thresholds without adjusting to any new result. Relative MAE uses mean absolute trajectory target as denominator; Pearson is required when target std > 1e-12 and at least 0.50 times its mean absolute value.
decision_basis.coverage: Reuse exactly 108 accepted deterministic episodes at k=1.00,1.15,1.30; add at most 72 in the same development maps at k=0.70,0.85. No refit, retraining, final split, or budget-selection split.
decision_basis.truth: Full, safe, in-budget arrival under the same frozen actor. Independent complete-trajectory targets use shared stopping and finite endpoints without critic bootstraps.
